name: ref_bloodmnist
label: REFERENCE search budget (paper Table 3): pop 100 x 30 gen, depth 3, p_cross 0.7, p_mut 0.15, 2 elites. CHEAP FITNESS PROTOCOL (decided 2026-10-27, fidelity-checked; see README section 5): each candidate trains <=5 minibatch epochs (patience 2, batch 256) on a fixed seeded 10k-sample subset of the training partition. Selection, final retraining (<=100 epochs, patience 15, batch 128) and the test evaluation use the full partitions. TWO-STAGE SELECTION (deviation D12, decided 2026-11-09 after the step-3 gate): every distinct valid formula of the final population is re-scored under the long protocol (<=30 epochs, patience 2, batch 128, full training partition, paired seeds) and the best re-scored formula is selected.
